Dans un milieu favorable, elle reste facile à trouver.

Pour en tirer ses propriétés, elle est réduite en poudre.

This stalk is found chiefly in mild temperate climates, especially in tall grasslands.

Even in suitable terrain, it remains easy to find.

To obtain its properties, it is ground into powder.

Level 9C Reduction poison. This silvery powder marks and scars the skin, inflicts 2–20 concussion hits, and can cause moderate general effects.
